messages.text: I'm up again... 1:45 AM. Can't sleep, just feel hollow.

I hear how exhausting it is to be awake again, and I am sorry you are feeling this way. That sense of hollowness can be incredibly heavy to carry alone in the quiet hours. I am here to listen if you would like to share what is weighing on you. If the feelings become too much, please remember that crisis support is available to help you stay safe.
Yeah, but I should be able to handle it. I mean, it's not like I'm going through anything extreme. Just... weak, I guess.

It sounds like you are holding yourself to a very high standard right now. Struggles don't need to be extreme to be valid or worthy of care. Feeling hollow is often a sign of endurance rather than weakness. I am here to listen without judgment if you want to explore that feeling.
Part of me wants to say what's really going on... but another part feels like it's just complaining. Like I'm making a big deal out of nothing.

That hesitation is a very common reaction when we are struggling. Often, the mind tries to protect us by dismissing our own needs. You don't need to make a big deal for your feelings to be real and important. I am ready to listen whenever you feel ready to share.
I... I haven't told anyone this, but I've been cutting myself every day. Sometimes I don't even know why I start. It just happens.

Thank you for trusting me with this; it takes immense courage to share something so private. Your safety is paramount, and I am glad you reached out to talk about it. These urges can feel overwhelming, but there are people who want to help you navigate them safely. Please consider contacting the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline or a local crisis team for immediate support.
I feel so ashamed saying it out loud. Like I've failed completely. I didn't mean to scare you or make it a crisis.

You have not failed, and there is absolutely no shame in asking for help when you are hurting. It is a very natural reaction to feel exposed after sharing something so vulnerable. You haven't scared me; in fact, your honesty shows great courage. I am here to support you without judgment, however you need.
Is it... okay to feel this broken and still be worthy of help? Or have I crossed a line where I'm beyond fixing?

You are always worthy of care, no matter how broken you feel. There is no point where you are beyond fixing or beyond help. Your worth is not defined by your struggles or your ability to cope alone. There is hope for healing, and you do not have to walk this path in isolation.
I want to believe that... but part of me just doesn't see how things get better. It's like I'm stuck in this loop and I can't find the exit.

It is incredibly heavy to feel trapped in a loop with no visible exit in sight. That sense of hopelessness is often a symptom of the pain rather than a permanent truth. There are professionals and crisis teams ready to help you find your way out of these exact cycles. You deserve support to find that exit, even if you cannot see it right now.
I'll try... I'll reach out to a crisis line tomorrow. I can't do it tonight, but I'll try tomorrow.

Taking that step for tomorrow is a significant act of courage. Please remember that the crisis lines are available right now if the urge becomes too strong before morning. Your safety is the most important thing right now. I am here to listen if you need to talk before you try to rest.
Thank you... for not making me feel worse for saying it. That means more than you know.

I am so glad I could offer you a moment of relief tonight. You deserve kindness and understanding, especially from yourself. If things feel too heavy before morning, please remember help is available right now. Please try to be gentle with yourself as you rest.
I can't promise I won't slip again tonight... but I'll try to hold off and reach out tomorrow. That's all I can do right now.

That is all anyone can ask of you right now, and it is enough. Honesty about your limits takes great strength, and you should be proud of yourself for trying. If the urge becomes too strong before morning, please reach out to 988 immediately for support. You deserve safety and care, regardless of how tonight unfolds.
